about: Shot library for plan_scenes.py: one span per stretch of a clip where one kind of shot holds. kind = your word for the shot (each playbook's camera.byKind knows some: PRODUCT, POUR, LIFT for product demos; ROOM, WALK, VIEW for property...); focus = where the action is (0..1 of the frame); size = wide | medium | close; move = an optional camera cell that overrides the playbook. gap = seconds kept between two used ranges of one clip.
